PK: id

Indexes: ix_billing_storage_daily_day(day) [index]; ix_billing_storage_daily_endpoint_day_account(storage_endpoint_id, day, s3_account_id) [index]; ix_billing_storage_daily_endpoint_day_user(storage_endpoint_id, day, s3_user_id) [index]; ix_billing_storage_daily_id(id) [index]; ix_billing_storage_daily_s3_account_id(s3_account_id) [index]; ix_billing_storage_daily_s3_user_id(s3_user_id) [index]; ix_billing_storage_daily_storage_endpoint_id(storage_endpoint_id) [index]; uq_billing_storage_daily_account(day, storage_endpoint_id, s3_account_id, source) [unique]; uq_billing_storage_daily_user(day, storage_endpoint_id, s3_user_id, source) [unique]

PK: id\nIndexes: ix_billing_assignments_endpoint_account_effective(storage_endpoint_id, s3_account_id, effective_from, effective_to) [index]; ix_billing_assignments_endpoint_user_effective(storage_endpoint_id, s3_user_id, effective_from, effective_to) [index]; ix_billing_assignments_id(id) [index]; ix_billing_assignments_rate_plan_id(rate_plan_id) [index]; ix_billing_assignments_s3_account_id(s3_account_id) [index]; ix_billing_assignments_s3_user_id(s3_user_id) [index]; ix_billing_assignments_storage_endpoint_id(storage_endpoint_id) [index]

PK: id
Unique: uq_billing_entity_group_membership_start(billing_entity_group_id, billing_entity_id, effective_from)
Check: ck_billing_entity_group_membership_period: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from
